description: This source file defines a REST API for managing jobs related to brand compliance analysis. It includes data models for requests and responses, and route handlers for creating, deleting, uploading assets, initiating analysis, fetching status, retrieving results, fixing assets and batch fixes, and downloading reports or reports as zip files. The endpoints connect to various services and manage workspace directories, serving as the main interface for the backend API of a brand compliance analysis tool.

classes.name: CreateJobRequest
classes.description: Model for request payload to create a new job, with optional owner, title, and description.

classes.name: CreateJobResponse
classes.description: Model for response payload containing the created job ID.

classes.name: StatusResponse
classes.description: Model representing the status details of a job, including progress metrics.

classes.name: FixAssetRequest
classes.description: Model for request payload to fix a specific asset, with optional strategy.

classes.name: BatchFixRequest
classes.description: Model for request payload to run batch fixes, with optional strategy.

methods.name: create_job(data: CreateJobRequest, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Handles creation of a new job, assigns a UUID, initializes workspace, and stores in state.

methods.name: delete_job(job_id: str, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Removes the job workspace directory and deletes job state.

methods.name: upload_assets_zip(job_id: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Accepts a zip file of assets, extracts it into the uploads directory, and updates job status.

methods.name: upload_old_brand(job_id: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Uploads an old brand reference image into the analysis folder.

methods.name: upload_new_brand(job_id: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Uploads a new brand reference image into the analysis folder.

methods.name: analyze_job(job_id: str, background: BackgroundTasks, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Triggers background analysis and preview generation for the specified job.

methods.name: get_status(job_id: str, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Retrieves the current progress and status details of a job.

methods.name: get_results(job_id: str, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Returns assets, issues, and optional summary information linked to a job.

methods.name: get_asset_preview( job_id: str, asset_id: str, view: Literal["original", "overlay", "fixed"] = Query("original", description="Preview type"), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store), )
methods.description: Serves a preview file for an asset based on the specified view type.

methods.name: fix_single_asset(job_id: str, asset_id: str, req: FixAssetRequest, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Performs an automatic fix on a specific asset and marks related issues as fixed.

methods.name: batch_fix(job_id: str, req: BatchFixRequest, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Runs automatic fixes across all assets that have issues for a given job.

methods.name: download_artifacts( job_id: str, type: Literal["zip", "report", "both"] = Query("zip", description="Artifact type to download"), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store), )
methods.description: Prepares and serves report or zip artifacts for download based on job ID.
